hero.heading: Electrical & Renewable Energy Services, Handled End To End
hero.text: From a single socket repair to a full industrial power upgrade — our licensed engineers design, install, and maintain it all.

intro.heading: Choose A Category To See What's Included

categories.heading: Wiring And Repairs Done Safely, The First Time
categories.text: We handle everything electrical inside your home — new builds, renovations, and repairs — with clean workmanship and code-compliant materials.

categories.heading: Power Systems Built For Demanding Operations
categories.text: We design and maintain the electrical backbone of shops, factories, and facilities — engineered for uptime and inspected on a schedule, not just when something breaks.

categories.heading: Solar Systems Designed Around Your Actual Usage
categories.text: We size and install solar systems that match your real power needs — grid-tied, hybrid, or fully off-grid — with a maintenance plan to protect your investment.

categories.heading: Never Lose Power At The Wrong Moment
categories.text: From homes to server rooms, we install backup systems that switch over automatically and keep voltage stable for sensitive equipment.

categories.heading: Protecting Your People, Property, And Equipment
categories.text: We add the safety and monitoring layer around your power system — lightning protection, inspections, and the surveillance infrastructure to match.

items.q: How long does a typical solar installation take?
items.a: Most residential systems are installed within 2–5 working days after site survey and material delivery, depending on system size and roof access.

items.q: Do you provide a warranty on your work?
items.a: Yes. All installations include a workmanship warranty, in addition to manufacturer warranties on panels, inverters, and batteries.

items.q: Can you work on occupied commercial buildings?
items.a: Yes, we plan installations and maintenance around your operating hours to minimize disruption to staff and customers.

items.q: Do you offer maintenance plans after installation?
items.a: Yes, we offer scheduled maintenance visits for solar, backup, and commercial power systems to keep performance consistent year-round.

items.q: Which areas of Liberia do you serve?
items.a: We are based in Monrovia and serve clients across Montserrado County, with project work available nationwide on request.

cta.heading: Not Sure Which Service You Need?
cta.text: Describe your project and our team will recommend the right solution.
